label: JZ Mock A · Paper 2 · Question 14
knowledgePattern: Select the local minimum and impose strict quadrant signs
solution:
The derivative is y′=a2−x2. For a≠0, it is negative outside [−|a|,|a|] and positive inside, so the local minimum is at x=−|a|. Its height is a−(2/3)|a|3.

If a<0, this height is negative, so the minimum is not in the second quadrant. If a>0, the minimum has coordinates (−a,a−2a3/3). The second quadrant requires a−2a3/3>0.

Dividing by positive a gives a2<3/2. Hence 0<a<3/2. At a=0 there is no local minimum, and at the other endpoint the height is zero. Answer A.

hints.body: Substitute the minimum input into the original curve. Require a negative horizontal coordinate and a positive height.
